control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of MAG-9601 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on MAG-9601 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. MAG-9601 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 3 September 2014 an incident occurred on MAG-9601 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
